senses.gloss: chaka (nt.; = Pali id., Childers and Geiger 〔40.1a〕; only chakana reported in Pali literature; = Skt. śakṛt), dung: in Mv 〔ii.71.14〕 (vs) read chaka-mūtram eva sṛjaṃ (= sṛjan, pres. pple.) for Senart charda-gūtham … (mss. chada-mūrtam, or chanda-mūrtem); my reading is proved by the corresponding prose 〔70.9〕 uccāra-prasrāvaṃ muñcamāno.
